go_usage.text: How it works: /go <task number> runs it, /go <number> dry previews it without editing.

help.text:
Confederate Fandom — a bot for Fandom wikis: news on the main pages, a nightly standardisation of names, and the scripts run on request.

Wiki work
/tasks — what the bot can do, as a numbered list
/run [numbers or codes] — set up a run; the bot asks which wiki, where the pages come from and what to do
/go <number> — start a prepared task; /go <number> dry previews it without editing
/jobs — what is running and how the last tasks ended
/stop <number> — stop a task
/schedule — the repeating runs; /schedule on|off|del <number>

News
/status — what the three slots hold and when the last pass ran
/update — rebuild the news now; with «force», the pictures too
/backfill — read the channel's web preview; with «all», refresh what the bot heard itself as well

Access
/wikiadmin — who is a wiki administrator; /wikiadmin <@name or ID> <Fandom account> appoints one
/remwikiadmin <@name or ID> — remove one

The commands are for the bot's administrators; the wiki work is also for wiki administrators who hold rights on that wiki.

mech_addtext_desc.text: add a block of text at the top, at the bottom or before the categories

mech_category_desc.text: add, remove or move a category across pages

mech_category_graph_desc.text: the tree of subcategories under one, as text or as a .dot file

mech_cosmetic_desc.text: spaces in headings, indents, blank lines, a dash instead of a hyphen

mech_delete_desc.text: delete a list of pages; this cannot be undone by editing

mech_delinker_desc.text: take out of the articles the files that have already been deleted

mech_image_desc.text: swap a file for another, or take it out of everywhere it is shown

mech_interwiki_desc.text: complete the links between the language versions, move them to the end and sort them

mech_listpages_desc.text: write the page list to a file; changes nothing

mech_movepages_desc.text: rename pages by a rule: a prefix, a suffix or a regular expression

mech_pravopys_uk_desc.text: §126, §35 and §36 of the Ukrainian orthography, plus the typo list

mech_protect_desc.text: set or lift protection on editing, moving and re-uploading

mech_punct_ru_desc.text: spaces around marks, typography and the commas that are always required

mech_redirect_desc.text: fix double ones, point links straight at the target, find the broken ones

mech_replace_desc.text: find and replace text or a regular expression across pages

mech_revertbot_desc.text: undo one account's run of edits at the top of the history

mech_templatecount_desc.text: how many pages use the templates, and the list of them if asked

mech_typos_ru_desc.text: 607 typo rules, punctuation and cosmetics; the summary says what was actually corrected

mech_unlink_desc.text: remove the links to a page and leave the words behind

not_admin.text: This command is for the bot's administrators only.

param_image_from.text: Which file to swap or remove? Without the «File:» prefix.

param_image_to.text: Swap it for which file? A single dash «-» removes it altogether.

param_interwiki_flags.text: How to handle the interlanguage links?

param_list_flags.text: What to write about each page?

param_protect_expiry.text: For how long? «infinite» means for good.

param_punct_ru_flags.text: How far should the punctuation go?

param_redirect_mode.text: What to do with the redirects?

param_replace.text: Replace it with what? A single dash «-» deletes what was found.

param_revert_user.text: Whose edits should be undone? The account name on the wiki.

param_templates.text: Which templates to count? Comma-separated, without «Template:».

param_typos_ru_flags.text: What else to do beside the typos?

param_unlink_flags.text: What to do with the link's words?
